glosses: To become very angry or enraged; to throw a fit or go crazy.

examples.text: My dad flew off the handle when he saw the F grade on my report card.
But he added: “Look, it happens to everybody. I’ve flown off the handle way worse than Elon Musk did in the last 24 hours.”

glosses: To become angered or crazy; to lose control of one's senses or sanity.

examples.text: Dad came unhinged when he saw the report card with such bad grades.

glosses: Ponerse de mal humor, causar enojo.
Dicho de mares, vientos y otros fenómenos naturales, alborotarse, enfurecerse.
Sentir o manifestar furia, rabia, ira exaltada, cólera, irritación; ponerse furioso o iracundo.
Referido al mar, el viento, las condiciones climáticas o sociales: Ponerse peligroso, con gran fuerza y violencia.
